decisions: No new directory: both modules land beside their source in the existing src/calculator/champions package, so packages is empty.
engine.py keeps the cached-JSON stamps, _result_key and build_parser: the parser builder is the concept the name promises and every champion module reads it.
Published spelling: engine reads both entry_shape names across the boundary, so _certify_shared_instant is certify_shared_instant and _validate_entry_keys is validate_entry_keys.
